notes.title: Patch 1.1 is ready to join all versions of the game!
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

We recently announced the arrival of patch 1.1: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/970830/announcements/detail/2958263217266003868]find it here[/url]. After three weeks of public beta testing, the 1.1 patch is ready to be implemented on every version of The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos!

That delay was caused by a few fixes which had to be done on the patch before it could join the main game:

- Complete overhaul of the saving system
- Fixing a bug related to the “Restart the Battle” functionality
- Fixes for numbered achievements
- Fixes for a variety of minor reported bugs.
- Fixing a bug that altered the appearance of some weapons after saving in the middle of a fight.
- Text adjustments.
- Slight optimizations.

The overhaul of the saving system was especially important and time-consuming, since the patch could otherwise create major issues for players.

The update is currently available for all Windows versions; as usual, the Mac versions will be available tomorrow.

notes.title: The 1.1 Update is here!
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

The biggest update so far from The Amulet of Chaos is here: Update 1.1!

We noticed after the game's release that, despite our testing and debug phases, several unexpected bugs had been encountered by players when they were playing.
This is why we decided to pre-launch the 1.1 update in a public beta: The Amulet of Chaos's players have the choice to activate the "Publicbetapatch1.1" branch on Steam to get the new functionalities right now, or wait until next week for the update to be implemented to the full game, with potentially a few corrections.

To all those who decide to try the 1.1 update tonight, we ask you to report us any bug you come across the same way it's been done before, by sending screens and context via mail here: bugs@artefacts-studio.fr.

For technical reasons, this public beta will only be available for Windows users. Be sure to restart your Steam client so the new branch appears!
Access it by right-clicking on the game's name in your library > Proprieties > Betas > "Publicbetapatch1.1"

And now, the much awaited patch note:

Patch 1.1 (11/2020):
- The Ironman Mode is now available!
- Various save fixes:
    - General: An option to disable the auto saves has been implemented (the auto saves are now disabled by default)
    - General: It is no longer possible to erase an auto save with a manual save
    - Combat: The game no longer auto saves during every round of combat
    - Combat: When enabled, the auto save will be done every X minutes, X being chosen by the player in the options
    - Exploration: No modification in exploration
- Resistances' effects
We changed the way physical and magical resistance were taken into account when calculating area of effect's damages. Before this patch, there was only one dice roll for all enemies, and their resistances were compared to that one score. Now, there is one dice roll per enemy. This should reduce the impression that a spell either works perfectly or doesn't work at all
- Additional Informations
    - Saves now indicate whether they were done in combat or exploration, and if they are compatible with the game's current version
    - Informations about physical and magical resistance were added to the character's information tab in battle
We also made more informations visible you can more easily plan combos including crowd control:
    - Informations about buffs and debuffs' length were added in the inventory, the skilltree and in battle
We also made more informations visible you can get a better idea of some skills/spells/items' power
- Restart a battle
This functionality had been added to the Pause Menu during a battle and on the "Defeat" screen
- End of battle's appreciations
The different bonuses applied to your characters' XP gains are now visible and explained. In addition to this, your performances in battle will be commented by the party!
- Enhancement of the game's speed
Taking into account the community's feedback about the game being too slow, we've cut as much downtime as we could! You should notice visible ameliorations when interacting with an object while in exploration, and while executing an action in battle. The AI's reflexion time isn't affected by these modifications
- Letting you know when you're overcharged
One of the most frequent bug reports we got was not linked to a bug: if your party starts walking instead of running, it's just because your inventory is full. In order to stop the confusion, we made it much more visible when you're overcharged and are carrying too much weight
- The Born Leader achievement has been deleted
This achievement doesn't currently work the way we wanted it to, and a hard fix would be very heavy for the game and not really worth it. Given that only a few people unlocked it, we decided to delete it. For those of you who already unlocked it, we invite you to spread the legend of the mysterious 66th achievement!
- A lot of miscellaneous bug fixes
- Balance fixes (SPOILER ALERT)
    - PC's stuff: The Thief's Boots (light leather version) now grant you more movement in every direction (not just while retreating anymore)
    - Wheel of Misfortune: We slightly nerfed the wheel's buffs and debuffs
    - Books: The skills' damages were modified
    - Books: A bonus of magic resistance was added to the skill "Magic Reinforcement"
    - Codex Lich: Courage nerf
    - Barney: One mannequin that blocked the view has been deleted
    - Drunk Barney: Drunk Barney now summons spiders with an adjusted level
    - Team Mel: Mel now has 3 action points
    - Team Mel: His sidekicks are now more resistant
    - Guignax: The buff he receives at the beginning of the battle is now more powerful
    - Zangdar: The damages inflicted to his shield by music has been nerfed
    - Zangdar: Hit Points buff (except in Story mode)

notes.title: Patch Note n°3
notes.content:
Greetings, Adventurers!

Following yesterday's patch, new critical bugs have appeared. This is why we moved our schedule to release this emergency patch today, so that the players newly stuck and pick up their game where they left it!

Here's a list of today's bug fixes:

- General: Fixing a critical bug that triggers infinite loading screens when going from one floor to another.
- General: Fixing a showstopper bug that might happen when you deactivate the automatic turn endings in a game without the tutorial.
- General: Wounds tweaking in the tutorial.
- General: Incrase of the number of automatic saves, from 3 to 10.
- Combat: Fixing several showstopper bugs linked to specific critical failures
- Combat: fixing a showstopper bug that might happen during the kitchen fight and the fight against Dlul’s followers.
- Combat: Fixing a showstopper bug that might happen if you finish the Misfortune Wheel fight with a charmed character.
- Combat: Fixing a showstopper bug that might happen when an AI kills itself while charging an attack.
- AI: AI no longer sees PCs under Stealth when using an AOE.
- Exploration: Fixing a collision bug in the garden.
- Exploration: Fixing a showstopper bug that might happen when you interact with a merchant directly after changing the difficulty.
- Exploration: Fixing a bug in Binsc and Moo’s quest.
- Exploration: Fixing the secondary quest of Dwalin's Axe
- Exploration: Fixing the chicken library's bugs.

If you still encounter one of the bugs listed above, please report it to bugs@artefacts-studio.fr.
Feel free to report any the bugs you encounter there, this way we can fix them faster!

Thank you all for your patience and help!

notes.title: [Patch Notes] Patch 2 and Upcoming Patches!
notes.content:
Note: At the moment this news is posted, the patch is available for PC only. The Mac version will be available soon!

Greetings, Adventurers!

The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos has been available since last Thursday on PC and Mac. We’re very proud to see how many of you have already started this epic and hilarious adventure!
We are very grateful for the bug reports we received from you all in order to fix the game’s problems as soon and as well as possible. A first patch was pushed this week-end to correct the first major problems we learned about and the second one is on its way!

[b]Today's patch aims to correct the following points:[/b]
- Combat: Correction of a showstopper bug following a critical failure during one of the Evil Thief’s attacks.
- Exploration: Loot tweaking in the tutorial.
- General: Correction of a critical bug that blocks loading your saves after a certain point during Chapter 6.
- General: Correction of a critical bug which prevents the game from launching if a save has been corrupted.

We do not intend to stop here! Before the end of this week, a new patch will be ready and, if necessary, another will shortly follow. [b]Here are the points we intend to correct with those upcoming patches:[/b]
- Combat: Fixing a showstopper bug linked to a critical failure when launching the Dwarf.
- Combat: fixing a showstopper bug that might happen during the kitchen fight and the fight against Dlul’s followers.
- Combat: Fixing a showstopper bug that might happen if you finish the Misfortune Wheel fight with a charmed character.
- Exploration: Fixing a collision bug in the garden.
- Exploration: Fixing a showstopper bug that might happen when you interact with a merchant directly after changing the difficulty.
- Exploration: Fixing a bug in Binsc and Moo’s quest.
- General: Fixing a showstopper bug that might happen when you deactivate the automatic turn endings in a game without the tutorial.
- General: Wounds tweaking in the tutorial.
- General: Incrase of the number of automatic saves, from 3 to 10.

If you noticed a bug that is not listed above, please report it to our new email address made especially for this purpose: bugs@artefacts-studio.fr

Thank you all!

notes.title: [Patch Notes] Patch 1: General bug fixes live now!
notes.content:
Note: at the time of publication, the patch is live on PC and will soon be live on MAC.

Hello adventurers!

The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos just launched on Thursday and we've consistently been reading your feedback since! We're very happy with the game's reception, you seem to be many enjoying spending time with our crazy cast of characters and exploring the dungeon.

We've also seen some of you report bugs and issues. The dev team is still hard at work on the game, taking your feedback to support the game post launch and deliver patches. So without further ado, here are the patch notes!

- AI: Rare game progression bug fixed
- AI: The chickens' AI has been altered so that they prefer to hit characters rather than furniture
- Controller support: now fully functional when the controller is plugged in after the game has already been launched
- Combat: Bug where the game didn't progress at the end of a fight when you finished by killing an enemy covered in beer/ice/poison/fire has been fixed
- Exploration: VIP Square entrance progression bug has been fixed
- Exploration: Game progression bug happening in the Binsc & Moo quest has been fixed
- General: Bug causing increased dodging/blocking and resistance than anticipated has been fixed 
- General: Maximum FPS without V-sync has been reduced from 240 to 120
- General: Some game text has been corrected 

Thank you again for your support and see you around in the dungeon of Naheulbeuk!

notes.title: New Announcement Date and New Characters for The Amulet of Chaos
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35395224/794a81bd57d8beb5729f00629ac6ef1c7e377904.jpg[/img]

Hi, everyone!

We have two things to tell you today.

First things first: we’re going to be late. In order to finish The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos properly, to polish it and make it the best it can be, we are pushing the release date to [b]September 17th[/b].
We’ve been set back by a few fumbles, but nothing too critical. We just need some more rounds to catch up! There’s no need to worry though: we locked up the developers with the Dwarf until the game is ready.

On a happier note, we also have a new trailer for you. Today, discover [b]the Companions[/b], three specific characters among which only one will join your party permanently as the eighth adventurer :
[list]
[*] [b]The Minstrel[/b], an obnoxious half-elf bard whose music offers great support to the party.
[*] [b]The Paladin[/b], a powerful fighter who serves the Goddess of Justice. For those who played the demo in June, you already met her!
[*] [b]The Priestess[/b], a condescending, but skilled healer, who would use the party as much as they’d use her.
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LpgJ3dVxTPI

You’ll be able to “try” each of these companions, as they will briefly join you for short quests (like the Paladin in the demo) before you’re offered the opportunity to recruit one of them. Find which one suits you the best!
